complete_attention_over_ffn_ratio.definition: (native RMS/QKV/RoPE + attention + output projection) / native FFN

hardware.uncertainty: Per-state median absolute deviation across measured repetitions/inputs. The sum of selected marginal MADs is an arithmetic diagnostic, not an independence assumption, confidence interval, or error bound.

same_input_cost_validation.input_scope: first fixed real bank input; current observation and same seed for all routes

budgets.interpretation: U and W executed identical masks; wall/event differences measure order and runtime variation, not a change in skipped computation.

limitations: Hot means cover only complete five-request cycles starting at the fourth Full/replan15, with coverage counts reported.
Full hot time remains a peak; five-request averages do not establish per-request deadline compliance.
Cold graph capture is subtracted in hot time but retained in all-request latency, total capture, and real evaluation throughput.
Condition trajectories differ; observed free-loop VLM, RPC and wall differences cannot by themselves identify a hardware-operator or objective speedup.
RPC time includes queue/transport and episode walls overlap across workers; summed episode walls are not the global evaluation duration.
Same-input cost-validation U/W masks may coincide; their timing differences are explicitly not algorithmic gains.
Hardware layer costs and joint AF savings are locally additive estimates; use actual validation and closed-loop runtime alongside them.
